mapper.insert: insert into comment (comment_content, board_id, member_id, parent_comment_id) values (#{commentContent}, #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{parentCommentId})
mapper.select: select c.comment_id, c.comment_content, c.board_id, c.member_id, c.reg_date, m.member_name, c.parent_comment_id from comment c join member m on c.member_id = m.member_id where board_id = #{boardId} order by reg_date desc
mapper.update: update comment set comment_content = #{commentContent} where comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: select c.comment_id, c.comment_content, m.member_name, c.reg_date, c.board_id from comment c join member m on m.member_id = c.member_id join board b on b.board_id = c.board_id order by c.reg_date desc limit #{start}, #{count}
